facts.fact: 室友 Cobblestone 已在 Clustersedge 前因 First 不及格离开，Memory 通知几个旅程内补新室友。
三人集群时 Gardenpath 首次带着「Murtis 体验」作对照，细析膜间流过的印象：疲惫、决心、关怀、好笑、高草气味。
facts.anchor: Exhaustion, determination, care, something funny, the smell of tall grass

facts.fact: 蓝铃花染膜与 wander 后，Gardenpath 决定去见秘密顾问，讲在庞贝学到的一切。
facts.anchor: It was time to meet up with their secret mentor

facts.fact: Gardenpath 向 Column 与 Oriel 讲 Unnamed 的废物仪式：固体埋掉或冲海，液体存缸重用。
facts.anchor: Unnamed have solid and liquid waste, with different rituals for each

facts.fact: 文化揭示：Unnamed 自称 men——「人的词就是 men」；Murtis 是 woman。
facts.anchor: I asked Murtis what the Unnamed call themselves, and they said

facts.fact: 两性外观完全一样（臂数眼数相同、常同色、同振动），性别靠语法标记，极难从外表猜。
facts.anchor: Male and female Unnamed look exactly the same

facts.fact: Oriel 听完 money 可交易一切、连另一个 Unnamed 都行，惊呼「they have slaves!」。
facts.anchor: You can trade money for anything, even another Unnamed

facts.fact: Column 听完 micro-tentacle 实验后震怒：改动了对方生命形、可能污染数据，威胁再犯亲自报学术参议院。
facts.anchor: I will report you to the Academic Senate myself
